title: Match rules
description: data/rules/match.json: match-wide gameplay values, copied into MatchRules (developer settings, compared before online matches). Editor aid only: Sim.Data's validator is authoritative (src/Sim.Data/Rules).

roundStartDistance.description: Each fighter's distance from the stage centre when a round starts, in subpixels; less than wallDistance.

wallDistance.description: Each stage wall's distance from the stage centre, in subpixels. Fighters' pushboxes stay between the walls.

maxPlayerDistance.description: The farthest the fighters may stand apart, outer pushbox edge to outer pushbox edge, in subpixels: the width the logic camera sees. At most twice wallDistance, more than twice roundStartDistance.

tradeRule.description: When both fighters' attacks connect on the same frame: trade = both hits land, clash = neither lands (both attacks are spent).

roundTimerFrames.description: Round timer length in logic frames (99 s = 5940). It stops during a global freeze; when it runs out, the larger share of max health left wins the round (equal = draw).

roundsToWin.description: Round wins that win the match (2 = best of 3). A draw gives both players a round win, unless that would give both their last win: then an extra deciding round is played.

maxRounds.description: The last round a match can reach (only through extra rounds after draws); still undecided after it, the match is a draw. At least 2 x roundsToWin - 1.

roundOverFrames.description: Frames between a KO or time-out and the next round (or match over). The logic keeps running with neutral input so the KO'd fighter can fall and land.

entitiesPerPlayer.description: Entity pool slots per player: projectiles (and module objects) one player can have out at once. A spawn when the owner's slots are full is refused; the other player's slots are separate. At most 8, the slots the match state reserves per player (EntityPool.MaxPerPlayer).

counterHitExtraHitstun.description: Counter hit (a hit during the defender's attack startup or active frames, ADR-0017): frames added to the hit's hitstun. A move's hit may set its own counterHit bonus instead.

counterHitExtraHitstop.description: Counter hit: frames added to the hit's hitstop (both fighters for an attack, the defender for a projectile).

counterHitExtraDamagePercent.description: Counter hit: damage added as a percentage of the hit's damage, rounded down (20 = 120 %).

punishCounterExtraHitstun.description: Punish counter (a hit during the defender's attack recovery, ADR-0017): frames added to the hit's hitstun. A move's hit may set its own punishCounter bonus instead.

punishCounterExtraHitstop.description: Punish counter: frames added to the hit's hitstop.

punishCounterExtraDamagePercent.description: Punish counter: damage added as a percentage of the hit's damage, rounded down.

throwTechWindowFrames.description: Frames after a grab in which the thrown fighter techs by inputting a throw (any direction); the throw lands when they run out (P1-23).

wakeUpThrowInvulnerableFrames.description: Frames after wake-up ends in which a fighter can't be thrown.

landingThrowInvulnerableFrames.description: Frames from landing (the first frame on the ground included) in which a fighter can't be thrown.

throwVsStrike.description: When a throw grabs on the same frame the defender's strike hits the thrower: throw = the throw grabs and the strike is dropped, strike = the strike hits and the throw doesn't grab.

shortcutDamagePercent.description: Damage and chip of hits from a move started with its special button shortcut, in percent (ADR-0020).

shortcutCooldownFrames.description: Frames after a shortcut move starts before the special button starts another; motions are never locked (ADR-0020).

pushbackFrames.description: Frames a hit's or block's pushback (the hit's pushback distance) takes to slide the defender away; in the corner the rest pushes the attacker back.

airRecovery.description: true: a fighter whose hitstun ends in the air recovers into a free jump; false: air hitstun lasts until landing, then a knockdown (ADR-0022).
